value.rationale: The natural problem of simultaneous attainability for a Fibonacci recurrence at two coprime prime-power moduli is obstructed by shared index parity. The exact fiber classification, first finite support 35 of 77, and double density 523/1848 quantify a genuine nonmultiplicative phenomenon, whereas multiplying existing separate image densities incorrectly predicts 5945/14784. This is a complete two-parameter invariant rather than a routine single-prime increment.
